plan.title: bug(hooks): raise Cursor spawn/tool.before timeout so gated ritual is not opaque failClosed exit-1

narratives.Description: Cursor preToolUse deposits use failClosed true and timeout 5 for Task/spawn matchers. After scope activate, Task is blocked with only host failClosed exit-1 because inspectMutationGates/verifySessionRitual can exceed 5s. hook-dispatch should exit 0 for allow/deny (#2864).
narratives.UserStory: As a Cursor user with an active xBRIEF and fresh gated ritual, I want Task/spawn preToolUse to return a Directive allow or coded deny within the deposit timeout, so that Multitask is not blocked by opaque host exit-1.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: In packages/core/src/init-deposit/agent-hooks (and related deposit defaults), raise Cursor Task/spawn tool.before timeout above known gated-ritual cost, and/or skip redundant re-verify when inspect is already green. Keep active-xBRIEF implement gate (#3080). Tests lock new defaults; CHANGELOG if user-visible. Do not edit authz classify (owned by #3245).
narratives.Overview: bug(hooks): raise Cursor spawn/tool.before timeout so gated ritual is not opaque failClosed exit-1

narrative.Acceptance: Given Cursor spawn/tool.before deposit defaults, when inspected, timeout is above gated-ritual cost OR mutation path skips redundant re-verify when already green; approach documented.

items.title: Raise deposit timeout or short-circuit green ritual

narrative.Acceptance: Given active xBRIEF and ready ritual under normal load, when Task is evaluated, result is allow or coded deny, not only opaque Cursor failClosed exit-1.

items.title: Decision path not only host exit-1

narrative.Acceptance: Given empty xbrief/active, when unmarked Task runs, deny message for no active xBRIEF still works.

items.title: Clean deny without active xBRIEF intact
